_comment: Per-record manual corrections, keyed by feature ID (e.g. 'osm:node/123' or 'burton:city-hall'). Applied AFTER the merge, so they survive every OSM re-fetch. Each entry may override any property, set 'coordinates': [lng, lat], or set 'hidden': true to drop a record. Curated facility coordinates/addresses now live directly in facilities.geojson; this file is reserved for hiding OSM duplicates.
